name: Kitso Handshake
_note: Single source of truth for Kitso Handshake versions. spec_version is the protocol/model version (README + CHANGELOG); wire_version is the frozen on-the-wire format (schema $id paths, well-known path, and the well-known 'protocol_version' const). They are intentionally decoupled — every change since v0.2 is additive and backward-compatible on the same wire schemas. README, CHANGELOG, schemas, and the operator well-known doc MUST agree with this file; tools/validate_protocol.py enforces that in CI.
